s.note: the townsfolk's welcome for the new sheriff
s.how: Cook 3 diced Granny Smiths with 30g butter, 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon until soft and cool. Line a 12-hole tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust, fill and lid with a third sheet. Egg wash and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Melt 40g butter with 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp bourbon. Toss with 200g peanuts and 150g pecans. Roast at 160C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Cool on the tray.

m.note: the railroad crew's supper on the trail
m.how: Season 4 rib eyes heavily with salt and cracked pepper. Sear over hot coals or in a cast iron pan and rest 8 minutes. In the same pan, fry 800g sliced potatoes and 2 onions slowly in 50g butter until golden.

w.note: dessert on the trail out of Rock Ridge
w.how: Toss 4 sliced peaches and 250g blackberries with 80g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.how: Pour four 375ml cans of sarsaparilla over plenty of ice in tall glasses and serve straight away. For the cowboys, pour 45ml bourbon over ice in a short glass instead, and keep the beans away from the campfire.
